title: Excellent trip with history, lots of food and drinks
text: A comfortable walk for 3 hours with lots of interesting history about Sitges , 3 stops for Tapas food, Cava and beer. Wich was more than most of us could eat. The guide (sorry dont remember her name) was very nice.
author: Arnthor74

title: Super interesting experience
text: Very enjoyable 90 minute wander viewing historical Americano properties. We were allowed access into many properties & offered insights into past lives. Thank you Rosa for a great tour.
